sources.snippet: Overview sam-vit-base is the base-scale Vision Transformer variant of the Segment Anything Model developed by facebook. The model generates high-quality object segmentation masks from image prompts including points, bounding boxes, or partial mask inputs. sources.snippet: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) produces high quality object masks from input prompts such as points or boxes, and it can be used to generate masks for all objects in an image. It has been trained on a dataset of 11 million images and 1.1 billion masks, and has strong zero-shot performance on a variety of segmentation tasks.
